clusters.headline: Komisi III DPR Bahas RUU Tata Cara Pidana Mati Bersama Pemerintah
aiSummaryBullets: Komisi III DPR menyerahkan 266 daftar inventarisasi masalah terkait rancangan undang-undang tata cara pelaksanaan pidana mati kepada pemerintah.
Rancangan aturan ini menetapkan eksekusi pidana mati maksimal dilakukan 30 hari setelah penetapan oleh Jaksa Agung.

clusters.headline: Polri Holds Ethics Hearing For Brigjen Tedjo In Treason Probe
aiSummaryBullets: Brigjen Tedjo Kusumo is currently under investigation for alleged treason involving illegal surveillance of state officials and police candidates.
Bareskrim Polri has initiated an ethics hearing for the brigadier general while continuing to process evidence including banners and documents.

clusters.headline: MPR To Verify Qualifications Of Prabowo’s Vice President Candidates
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR has scheduled factual verification for vice presidential candidates Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono on November 25-26, 2026.
Candidates will be required to sign a commitment statement pledging they will not withdraw from the selection process.

clusters.headline: Erin Wartia And Former Housekeeper Resolve Abuse Legal Dispute
aiSummaryBullets: Erin Wartia and her former housekeeper, Herawati, have formally agreed to resolve their ongoing legal dispute through reconciliation.
The agreement follows a period of mutual police reports that resulted in Erin Wartia being named a suspect in an alleged abuse investigation.

clusters.headline: Search Operations Continue After Massive Fire At PT Fonusa Agung Mulia
aiSummaryBullets: Search and rescue teams have recovered 26 sets of remains, while approximately 28 to 30 workers remain reported missing.
Authorities have upgraded the factory fire case to a formal investigation due to suspected safety standard violations.

clusters.headline: Listyo Sigit And Five Suspects Accused Of Planning Treason Plot
aiSummaryBullets: Authorities identified six suspects in a treason case, including former police chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo and one civilian.
Bareskrim investigators allege the group planned to incite unrest during mass protests amid speculation regarding the National Police Chief position.

clusters.headline: Listyo Sigit Required To Attend Ethics Trial In Person On Thursday
aiSummaryBullets: Former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo is required to attend his ethics trial in person on November 26, 2026.
The ethics hearing concerns allegations of illegal wiretapping and treason directed toward President Prabowo Subianto.

clusters.headline: Mendagri Tito Karnavian Tekankan Empat Komponen Pertumbuhan Ekonomi
aiSummaryBullets: Minister of Home Affairs Tito Karnavian identified household consumption, government spending, investment, and net exports as four key regional growth drivers.
The ministry aims to strengthen national economic conditions by fostering investment and promoting the export of products from micro, small, and medium enterprises.

clusters.headline: KPK Expands Investigations Into Corruption At ATR/BPN Ministry
aiSummaryBullets: The KPK is scrutinizing the issuance process of land rights documents, specifically HGB and HGU titles, involving ministry officials.
Investigations into the ministry remain ongoing as part of a wider effort to address corruption allegations linked to land services.

clusters.headline: Government Agencies Prepare For Natal And Tahun Baru 2026-2027
aiSummaryBullets: Minister of Agriculture Andi Amran Sulaiman stated that national rice reserves reach 4.5 million tons, ensuring sufficiency for the holiday season.
PT Kereta Api Indonesia has deployed over 1,000 infrastructure personnel to monitor rail networks across Java for safe operations during the holidays.

clusters.headline: Polri And BNN Dismantle Indonesia-Malaysia Drug Smuggling Network
aiSummaryBullets: Authorities confiscated 378 kilograms of crystal methamphetamine linked to an international trafficking network between Indonesia and Malaysia.
The National Narcotics Agency (BNN) seized assets worth 57.7 billion rupiah, including vehicles and business properties, in a money laundering investigation.

clusters.headline: Korlantas Polri Investigates Multi-Vehicle Crash In Sumedang
aiSummaryBullets: The Korlantas Polri has deployed a Traffic Accident Analysis team to investigate the multi-vehicle collision in Sumedang.
The accident involving eight vehicles resulted in seven confirmed deaths.

clusters.headline: Bahlil Lahadalia Targets Indonesia Fuel Reserves Of Sixty Days
aiSummaryBullets: Coordinating Minister Bahlil Lahadalia is targeting a significant increase in national fuel reserves to reach a sixty-day supply.
Energy policies emphasize enhancing domestic production, downstream industry growth, and stronger collaboration with international energy firms.

clusters.headline: Kemenhut Tegaskan Ujung Kulon Tetap Menjadi Habitat Badak Jawa
aiSummaryBullets: Kementerian Kehutanan berkomitmen memperkuat konservasi badak jawa di Taman Nasional Ujung Kulon.
Pemerintah membantah akan mengeluarkan izin tambang meskipun terdapat potensi cadangan emas di wilayah tersebut.

clusters.headline: MPR Consults Experts On Mechanism For Selecting Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR Ad Hoc Committee has begun discussions on the formal mechanism for electing a new vice president.
Experts are scheduled to be consulted by the committee during an upcoming meeting to refine the selection process.

clusters.headline: Regional Minimum Wage 2027 Adjustments Announced Across Indonesia
aiSummaryBullets: Provincial minimum wages for 2027 have been announced, with Jakarta setting the rate at Rp6.1 million.
The Ministry of Manpower warned that employers failing to meet minimum wage regulations face potential fines of Rp200 million or prison terms.

clusters.headline: Indonesia And European Union Sign IEU-CEPA Trade Agreement
aiSummaryBullets: The IEU-CEPA agreement will allow many Indonesian products to enter the European market with zero percent import duties.
Trade Minister Budi Santoso confirmed that the influx of European imports will be monitored to prevent disruption to domestic industries.

clusters.headline: Listyo Sigit And Five Others Named Suspects In Makar Case In Indonesia
aiSummaryBullets: Bareskrim Polri officially named former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit and five other personnel as suspects in a treason case.
Investigators allege the group planned actions against the administration, including the unauthorized wiretapping of high-profile figures.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto Emphasizes Regional Cooperation and Partnerships
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto highlights the importance of collaboration, openness, and innovation for shared regional prosperity.
Bahlil Lahadalia emphasizes that regional power sector agreements must prioritize Indonesian national interests.

clusters.headline: Fire Damages 75 Buildings In Tambora Leaving 400 Residents Affected
aiSummaryBullets: A fire broke out in the residential area of Jembatan Besi 1, Tambora, West Jakarta, late on Monday evening.
The blaze resulted in the destruction of 75 structures, including homes and rented units, affecting approximately 400 residents.
